alerts.header: Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between College and Osgoode stations, starting 11:59 p.m., on Friday, November 27, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: No service between St George and Woodbine stations due to a security incident at Broadview station. Thank you for your patience.
